entries.en: The crime museum displayed a cosh beside other confiscated objects.
entries.zh: 犯罪博物馆把一根大头棍与其他没收物品放在一起展出。

entries.en: The designer's outre costumes attracted more attention than the music.
entries.zh: 设计师那些越出常轨的服装比音乐更引人注目。

entries.en: The old physics table expresses energy in ergs.
entries.zh: 这张旧物理表用尔格表示能量。

entries.en: The broody hen stayed on the nest while the others wandered outside.
entries.zh: 那只抱窝的母鸡留在巢上，其他鸡则在外面走动。

entries.en: The cafe served warm blini with sour cream.
entries.zh: 咖啡馆供应配有酸奶油的热俄式薄煎饼。

entries.en: The pseudonymous author declined to reveal who had written the letters.
entries.zh: 这位使用笔名的作者拒绝透露信件的作者身份。

entries.en: The straightforwardness of her answer helped restore trust after the disagreement.
entries.zh: 她回答得坦率，有助于在分歧之后恢复信任。

entries.en: The interview protocol describes the elicitation of detailed memories through open questions.
entries.zh: 访谈方案描述了通过开放式问题引出详细回忆的方法。

entries.en: The deleted draft remained retrievable from the backup archive.
entries.zh: 删除的草稿仍然可以从备份档案中恢复。

entries.en: The cyclists warmed up on the velodrome before the first race.
entries.zh: 自行车选手在第一场比赛前在自行车赛车场热身。

entries.en: The warehouseman checked each delivery against the inventory list.
entries.zh: 仓库管理员对照库存清单检查了每批到货。

entries.en: The report compared research spending at several large pharmas.
entries.zh: 报告比较了几家大型制药公司的研究支出。

entries.en: The actor glared murderously at the rival character across the stage.
entries.zh: 演员隔着舞台凶残地瞪着那个对手角色。

entries.en: Her telegraphic notes omitted articles but preserved the main events.
entries.zh: 她简短的笔记省略了冠词，但保留了主要事件。

entries.en: The official listened stonily as the residents described their losses.
entries.zh: 居民讲述损失时，那位官员冷酷地听着。

entries.en: The article relied on unverifiable accounts from unnamed witnesses.
entries.zh: 这篇文章依赖无法核实的匿名证人叙述。

entries.en: The letter expresses unmeasured gratitude for the family's kindness.
entries.zh: 这封信对那家人的善意表达了无限的感激。

entries.en: A lei of white flowers rested on the wooden table.
entries.zh: 一串白花编成的花环放在木桌上。

entries.en: The clinical interview included questions about persistent dysphoria.
entries.zh: 临床访谈中包含了有关持续烦躁不安的问题。

entries.en: A shortish path connects the station to the riverside museum.
entries.zh: 一条相当短的小路把车站与河边博物馆连接起来。

entries.en: The historian questioned the painting's idealized portrayal of an odalisque.
entries.zh: 历史学家质疑了这幅画对宫廷女奴隶的理想化描绘。

entries.en: The inspection found several remediable faults in the roof.
entries.zh: 检查发现屋顶有几处可以补救的缺陷。

entries.en: The curator explained that the preserved snake had been defanged before acquisition.
entries.zh: 策展人解释说，这条保存下来的蛇在被收藏之前已经被拔去了尖牙。

entries.en: A bodiless voice speaks from behind the wall in the play.
entries.zh: 剧中，一个没有躯体的声音从墙后传来。

entries.en: The counterman set two bowls of soup beside the cash register.
entries.zh: 柜台服务员把两碗汤放在收银机旁。

entries.en: The ball caromed off the wall and rolled beneath the bench.
entries.zh: 球撞墙反弹，滚到了长椅下面。

entries.en: As the chooser of the final photograph, she preferred the quieter image.
entries.zh: 作为最终照片的选择者，她更喜欢那张较为宁静的影像。

entries.en: The disagreement seemed resolvable once both teams shared their records.
entries.zh: 两个团队共享记录后，这场分歧似乎就可以解决了。

entries.en: Fairness remained the lodestar of the committee's difficult discussions.
entries.zh: 公平始终是委员会艰难讨论中的指导原理。

entries.en: The sternness of the judge's warning silenced the courtroom.
entries.zh: 法官警告的严厉使法庭安静下来。

entries.en: The college library expanded its collection of chiropody textbooks.
entries.zh: 学院图书馆扩充了足病学教材的收藏。

entries.en: The speaker read the figures boringly from an overcrowded slide.
entries.zh: 发言者沉闷地照着一张内容过密的幻灯片念数字。

entries.en: Slices of chicken were arranged inside a clear aspic.
entries.zh: 鸡肉片被摆放在透明的花色肉冻里。

entries.en: The engineering team recorded the motor's output with a dynamometer.
entries.zh: 工程团队用功率计记录了电机的输出功率。

entries.en: The farmer repaired a broken gate beside the pigpen.
entries.zh: 农场主修好了猪舍旁的一扇坏门。

entries.en: The anatomical drawing labels several celiac structures in the abdominal cavity.
entries.zh: 这幅解剖图标出了腹腔内的几处结构。

entries.en: The illusionary depth of the painted doorway fooled several visitors.
entries.zh: 画中门口造成的深度错觉骗过了几位游客。

entries.en: The librarian's amiability made nervous newcomers feel welcome.
entries.zh: 图书管理员的和蔼可亲让紧张的新来者感到受欢迎。

entries.en: The diagram marks the inspiratory phase with a blue arrow.
entries.zh: 图中用蓝色箭头标出了吸气阶段。

entries.en: An inkblot spread across the unfinished signature.
entries.zh: 一个墨水斑点在尚未写完的签名上扩散开来。

entries.en: The collector kept an old silver twopence in a labeled envelope.
entries.zh: 收藏者把一枚旧的两便士银币放在有标签的信封里。

entries.en: The microscope image highlights eosinophilic cells in the sample.
entries.zh: 显微镜图像突出显示了样品中的嗜酸性细胞。

entries.en: The unexpected result came from a misapplication of the formula.
entries.zh: 出乎意料的结果源于对公式的误用。

entries.en: The character insolently interrupted the mayor during the ceremony.
entries.zh: 这个人物在仪式中无礼地打断了市长。

entries.en: The haymaker stood idle at the edge of the field after the harvest.
entries.zh: 收割后，干草机闲置在田边。

entries.en: The interviewer avoided leading questions because some participants were highly suggestible.
entries.zh: 访谈者避免使用诱导性问题，因为一些参与者很容易受暗示。

entries.en: Water from the artesian well flowed into a shallow stone basin.
entries.zh: 自流井的水流进一个浅石盆中。

entries.en: A roundish pebble held the folded map in place.
entries.zh: 一块略圆的鹅卵石压住了折好的地图。

entries.en: The chartist compared several price graphs before writing the market report.
entries.zh: 这位图解专家比较了几张价格图，然后撰写市场报告。

entries.en: The choir sang a canticle near the end of the service.
entries.zh: 唱诗班在礼拜快结束时唱了一首圣歌。

entries.meaningZh: 沉浸在柔和的微光中的
entries.en: We crossed the twilit courtyard without disturbing the sleeping dog.
entries.zh: 我们穿过笼罩在柔和微光中的庭院，没有惊动熟睡的狗。

entries.en: A butterball dived beneath the ripples near the reed bed.
entries.zh: 一只小潜鸭钻入芦苇丛旁的涟漪下面。

entries.en: The snorer in the next bunk kept the other travelers awake.
entries.zh: 隔壁铺位上的打鼾者让其他旅客睡不着。

entries.en: A heavy crossbeam supports the center of the barn roof.
entries.zh: 一根沉重的横梁支撑着谷仓屋顶的中央部分。

entries.en: The proposed route proved infeasible because the bridge was closed.
entries.zh: 由于桥梁关闭，拟议路线被证明不可实行。

entries.en: She marked the campsite on the wall map with a green pushpin.
entries.zh: 她用一枚绿色图钉在墙上的地图中标出了营地。

entries.en: The oppressive heat brought a mood of listlessness to the office.
entries.zh: 闷热使办公室里弥漫着无精打采的气氛。

entries.en: The pharmacology chart groups each antihypertensive by its general drug class.
entries.zh: 药理学图表按大类对各种抗高血压药进行了归类。

entries.en: The gilder restored the thin gold surface of the antique frame.
entries.zh: 镀金工人修复了古董画框表面的薄金层。

entries.en: Each examinee received a numbered booklet before the test began.
entries.zh: 考试开始前，每位应试者收到了一本编号的小册子。

entries.en: The coastal region began to industrialise after the railway reached the port.
entries.zh: 铁路通达港口后，这片沿海地区开始工业化。

entries.en: The sample was collected from an anoxic region of the lake bed.
entries.zh: 这个样品采自湖床的一个缺氧区域。

entries.en: A bottle of catsup stood beside the mustard on the diner table.
entries.zh: 餐馆桌上的芥末旁放着一瓶调味番茄酱。

entries.en: The accordionist played beneath the station clock as commuters passed.
entries.zh: 通勤者经过时，手风琴师在车站时钟下演奏。

entries.en: The reviewer criticized the narrator's egoistic treatment of everyone around him.
entries.zh: 评论者批评了叙述者对待身边所有人时自我中心的态度。

entries.en: The medical review discusses pica without treating unusual food preferences as a diagnosis.
entries.zh: 这篇医学综述讨论异食癖，但不把不寻常的食物偏好当作诊断。

entries.en: The collector's acquisitiveness gradually filled every room with antique clocks.
entries.zh: 收藏家的占有欲逐渐让每个房间都堆满了古董钟。

entries.en: Filamentous growth covered the surface of the laboratory culture.
entries.zh: 细丝状的生长物覆盖了实验室培养物的表面。

entries.en: The model includes several processes that are unobservable with the available instruments.
entries.zh: 该模型包含几个现有仪器无法直接观察的过程。

entries.en: The sudden glare from the mirrors bedazzled the approaching visitors.
entries.zh: 镜面突然反射出的强光使走近的游客眼花缭乱。

entries.en: The chart marks a busy seaway between the two islands.
entries.zh: 海图标出了两座岛屿之间的一条繁忙海运航线。

entries.en: The novel follows a highborn traveler who conceals her family name.
entries.zh: 小说讲述了一位隐瞒家族姓氏、出身名门的旅行者的经历。

entries.en: The analyst checked whether the two measurement errors were uncorrelated.
entries.zh: 分析人员检查了这两个测量误差是否不相关。

entries.en: The new cable hung inelegantly across the otherwise tidy doorway.
entries.zh: 新电缆不美观地悬在原本整洁的门口上方。

entries.en: He sank languorously into the armchair after the long afternoon outdoors.
entries.zh: 在户外度过漫长的下午后，他疲倦地陷进了扶手椅。

entries.en: The essay examines animistic beliefs about rivers and mountains.
entries.zh: 这篇文章考察了有关河流和山岳的万物有灵论信仰。

entries.en: The baker decorated the chocolate gateau with curls of white chocolate.
entries.zh: 面包师用白巧克力卷装饰了那个精美的巧克力大奶油蛋糕。

entries.en: The property inventory lists the garden shed as an appurtenance of the house.
entries.zh: 房产清单将花园棚屋列为房屋的附属物。

entries.en: The survey describes a dark bituminous layer beneath the gravel.
entries.zh: 勘测报告描述了砾石下面一层含沥青的深色物质。

entries.en: The costume designer chose a collarless linen shirt for the scene.
entries.zh: 服装设计师为这个场景选了一件无领亚麻衬衫。

entries.en: Moving from the grand hotel to a cramped room felt like a comedown.
entries.zh: 从豪华酒店搬进狭窄房间，感觉像是境遇衰落了。

entries.en: The diagram explains the lamination of several thin wooden sheets.
entries.zh: 示意图解释了几层薄木片的层积过程。

entries.en: His ungracious response embarrassed the volunteer who had offered help.
entries.zh: 他无礼的回应让主动帮忙的志愿者感到尴尬。

entries.en: The market stall displayed a silver pompano on crushed ice.
entries.zh: 市场摊位把一条银色鲳参鱼摆在碎冰上。

entries.en: The laboratory reference collection contains a labeled sample of theophylline.
entries.zh: 实验室的参考样品收藏中有一份标明名称的茶叶碱样品。

entries.en: The evasiveness of the reply frustrated reporters seeking a clear answer.
entries.zh: 回答的模棱两可让寻求明确答案的记者感到沮丧。

entries.en: The arena hosted showjumping throughout the final afternoon of the festival.
entries.zh: 节日最后一个下午，竞技场一直在举办超越障碍马术比赛。

entries.en: The institute's metrology laboratory checks the accuracy of precision instruments.
entries.zh: 该研究所的测量学实验室检查精密仪器的准确性。

entries.en: The successful restoration will redound to the museum's credit.
entries.zh: 这次成功的修复将有助于提高博物馆的声誉。

entries.en: The novel describes the daily routines of an unconventional menage.
entries.zh: 小说描写了一个非传统家庭的日常生活。

entries.en: The fictional editor refused to print an unsupported and potentially libellous accusation.
entries.zh: 小说中的编辑拒绝刊登一项缺乏依据且可能构成诽谤的指控。

entries.en: The lecture introduces the electron as an example of a fermion.
entries.zh: 讲座以电子作为费米子的一个例子。

entries.en: A thick slice of gammon came with roasted vegetables.
entries.zh: 一片厚厚的腌猪后腿肉配着烤蔬菜端了上来。

entries.en: The old brickyard supplied materials for many nearby houses.
entries.zh: 这家旧砖厂曾为附近许多房屋提供材料。

entries.en: The field guide shows a bilberry growing beneath low woodland shrubs.
entries.zh: 这本野外指南展示了一株生长在林地低矮灌木下的欧洲越桔。

entries.en: The anatomical model marks the pubis in a contrasting color.
entries.zh: 解剖模型用对比色标出了耻骨。

entries.en: A dark residuum remained at the bottom of the flask.
entries.zh: 烧瓶底部留下了一层深色残留物。

entries.en: The pathology textbook includes a labeled image of a papilloma.
entries.zh: 这本病理学教材包含一幅标注了名称的乳头状瘤图像。

entries.en: The skeleton model shows the sacrum at the back of the pelvis.
entries.zh: 骨架模型展示了骨盆后部的骶骨。

entries.en: The survey asked adults whether they considered a blowjob a form of sexual activity.
entries.zh: 调查询问成年人是否把口交视为一种性活动。

entries.en: The graph distinguishes the expiratory phase from the inspiratory phase.
entries.zh: 图表区分了呼气阶段与吸气阶段。

entries.en: The archivist spent weeks trying to unscramble the mixed correspondence.
entries.zh: 档案管理员花了数周时间尝试整理混在一起的通信。

entries.en: The aimlessness of the journey becomes a central theme of the novel.
entries.zh: 这段旅程的漫无目的成为小说的一个核心主题。

entries.en: They togged themselves out in bright costumes for the parade.
entries.zh: 他们给自己穿上鲜艳的服装，准备参加游行。

entries.en: The loose railing moved scarily when the visitor touched it.
entries.zh: 游客碰到松动的栏杆时，栏杆晃得令人害怕。

entries.en: The intractability of the negotiations frustrated both delegations.
entries.zh: 谈判的难以驾驭使双方代表团都感到沮丧。

entries.en: The counselor listened empathetically while the student described the difficult move.
entries.zh: 学生讲述搬迁的艰难经历时，辅导员感同身受地倾听着。

entries.en: The unexpected question flummoxed the otherwise confident presenter.
entries.zh: 这个出乎意料的问题使原本自信的主讲人不知所措。

entries.en: The dog gazed dolefully at the closed kitchen door.
entries.zh: 那只狗悲哀地望着关着的厨房门。

entries.en: The case report describes the arrival of a hypothermic patient.
entries.zh: 病例报告描述了一名体温过低患者到达时的情况。

entries.en: Discolouration around the window frame suggested that water had entered the wall.
entries.zh: 窗框周围的变色表明水可能渗入了墙内。

entries.en: The schedule set an unachievable deadline for restoring the entire archive.
entries.zh: 这份时间表为修复整个档案设定了一个不可实现的截止期限。

entries.en: The biology lesson compares hermaphroditic animals with species having separate sexes.
entries.zh: 生物课把雌雄同体动物与雌雄异体的物种作了比较。

entries.en: The choirmaster asked the singers to repeat the final phrase more softly.
entries.zh: 唱诗班指挥请歌手们更轻柔地重复最后一个乐句。

entries.en: The reviewer brought a discriminative eye to the exhibition's uneven selection.
entries.zh: 评论者以有识别力的眼光审视了展览中良莠不齐的选品。

entries.en: A striped sunshade sheltered the table from the afternoon sun.
entries.zh: 一把条纹遮阳伞为桌子遮挡下午的阳光。

entries.en: The introductory chapter explains animism through beliefs about living landscapes.
entries.zh: 导论章节通过有关自然景观具有生命的信仰来解释万物有灵论。

entries.en: The pianist ended the recital with a quiet nocturne.
entries.zh: 钢琴家以一首安静的夜曲结束了独奏会。

entries.en: The diagram shows how the maxilla supports the upper teeth.
entries.zh: 示意图展示了上颌骨如何支撑上排牙齿。

entries.en: The book presents the village's history pictorially through a series of murals.
entries.zh: 这本书通过一系列壁画，以图画的方式呈现村庄的历史。

entries.en: The director allows the unlikable protagonist to reveal moments of unexpected kindness.
entries.zh: 导演让那位不讨喜的主人公流露出出人意料的善意。

entries.en: After the exhausting tour, the musician welcomed a recuperative week at home.
entries.zh: 疲惫的巡演结束后，音乐家对能在家休养一周感到欣慰。

entries.en: The historian contrasted the unreformed church with its Protestant neighbors.
entries.zh: 历史学家将这座未经宗教改革的教会与周边的新教教会作了比较。

entries.en: He sent his goddaughter a book of illustrated folktales.
entries.zh: 他送给教女一本带插图的民间故事书。

entries.en: The software keeps the page layout modifiable until the final export.
entries.zh: 软件让页面布局在最终导出之前都可以变更。

entries.en: The ferryman waited for the last passenger to board before leaving the bank.
entries.zh: 渡船工人等最后一位乘客上船后才离岸。

entries.en: The lecturer drew a plane to illustrate a subspace of three-dimensional space.
entries.zh: 讲师画了一个平面来说明三维空间的子空间。

entries.en: Lemon juice will acidify the dressing and sharpen its flavor.
entries.zh: 柠檬汁会使调味汁变酸，并让味道更鲜明。

entries.en: The essay identifies trust as the fundament of a durable partnership.
entries.zh: 这篇文章将信任视为持久合作关系的基础。

entries.en: The critic caustically described the lavish production as an expensive lullaby.
entries.zh: 评论家挖苦地把这部奢华制作称为一首昂贵的摇篮曲。

entries.en: The marina closes briefly while staff winterize the rental boats.
entries.zh: 工作人员为出租船只做好过冬准备期间，码头会暂时关闭。

entries.en: The historical account describes a granger tending fields beside the river.
entries.zh: 这份历史记述描写了一名在河边耕作的农夫。

entries.en: The orchestra repeated the allegro with a lighter touch.
entries.zh: 乐团以更轻巧的处理重复演奏了快板乐段。

entries.en: The character gives a coquettish smile before leaving the ballroom.
entries.zh: 这个人物在离开舞厅之前露出了卖弄风情的微笑。

entries.en: As a landlubber, he found even the gentle rolling of the boat unsettling.
entries.zh: 作为一个不习惯航海的人，即使船轻轻摇晃也让他不安。

entries.en: The documentary lets a stutterer describe his own experiences of public speaking.
entries.zh: 纪录片让一位口吃者讲述他自己公开发言的经历。

entries.en: The museum's majolica collection includes plates painted with fruit and birds.
entries.zh: 博物馆收藏的意大利锡釉陶器中，有画着水果和鸟的盘子。

entries.en: A hemispherical glass dome covered the delicate mechanical model.
entries.zh: 一个半球形玻璃罩罩着精巧的机械模型。

entries.en: The carpenter repaired the newel at the foot of the staircase.
entries.zh: 木匠修好了楼梯底部的端柱。

entries.en: The unlikelihood of another encounter made their reunion especially moving.
entries.zh: 再次相遇原本不大可能，这使他们的重逢格外动人。

entries.en: The film shows a distracted pedestrian jaywalking against a red light.
entries.zh: 影片中，一名分心的行人闯红灯乱穿马路。

entries.en: The phrase is translatable, although its rhythm is difficult to preserve.
entries.zh: 这个短语可以翻译，尽管它的节奏很难保留。

entries.en: A towboat guided the damaged vessel toward the repair dock.
entries.zh: 一艘拖船把受损船只引向维修码头。

entries.en: The observatory recorded auroral activity above the northern horizon.
entries.zh: 天文台记录了北方地平线上空的极光活动。

entries.en: The restored shopfront retained its original curved display windows.
entries.zh: 修复后的店面保留了原有的弧形橱窗。

entries.en: A beery smell lingered in the empty room after the party.
entries.zh: 聚会结束后，空房间里仍然残留着一股啤酒味。

entries.en: An unlit cheroot lay beside the character's hat in the painting.
entries.zh: 画中，一支未点燃的方头雪茄烟放在人物的帽子旁边。

entries.en: The exhibition presents phrenology as an abandoned theory about skull shape and character.
entries.zh: 展览将颅相学介绍为一种关于头骨形状与性格关系的已被摒弃的理论。

entries.en: The anatomy textbook includes a labeled diagram of clitoral structures.
entries.zh: 这本解剖学教材包含一张标注了名称的阴蒂结构图。

entries.en: The linguist distinguished a grapheme from the sound it represents.
entries.zh: 语言学家区分了字素与它所表示的语音。

entries.en: The cartoon satirically portrays a council meeting as a crowded circus.
entries.zh: 这幅漫画讽刺地把议会会议描绘成一个拥挤的马戏团。

entries.en: The prohibitionist addressed a crowded meeting in the town hall.
entries.zh: 这位禁酒主义者在市政厅向拥挤会场中的听众讲话。

entries.en: In the historical drama, the ruler orders the generals to embattle their forces.
entries.zh: 在这部历史剧中，统治者命令将军们整军备战。

entries.en: The pigeon returned to feed the squab in the sheltered nest.
entries.zh: 鸽子回到有遮蔽的巢中喂养雏鸟。

entries.en: The dated photograph established the falseness of the witness's account.
entries.zh: 这张标有日期的照片证实了证人叙述的不正确。

entries.en: The satire exposes the sycophancy surrounding the powerful minister.
entries.zh: 这部讽刺作品揭露了围绕那位权势部长的谄媚风气。

entries.en: The perfume bottle had a small brass atomizer.
entries.zh: 这只香水瓶配有一个小黄铜雾化器。

entries.en: The storm was no respecter of the carefully arranged festival schedule.
entries.zh: 这场暴风雨丝毫没有顾及精心安排的节日时间表。

entries.en: The photographer paused to refocus the camera on the distant tower.
entries.zh: 摄影师停下来重新调整相机焦距，对准远处的塔。

entries.en: A strip of black crape hung from the portrait frame.
entries.zh: 一条黑色绉纱挂在肖像画框上。

entries.en: The landlord's obduracy prevented any discussion of a shorter lease.
entries.zh: 房东的顽固使缩短租期的事根本无法商量。

entries.en: The anatomy chart marks the oropharyngeal region behind the mouth.
entries.zh: 解剖图标出了口腔后方的口咽区域。

entries.en: The narrator begins to moralise whenever the younger characters take a risk.
entries.zh: 每当年轻人物冒险时，叙述者就开始说教。

entries.en: The cover uses a photomontage of railway tracks and city rooftops.
entries.zh: 封面使用了一张由铁轨和城市屋顶组成的合成照片。

entries.en: The scientist thanked a confrere for identifying the error in the draft.
entries.zh: 这位科学家感谢一位同仁指出草稿中的错误。

entries.en: The laboratory compared the natural substance with one produced synthetically.
entries.zh: 实验室比较了这种天然物质与一种合成产物。

entries.en: The scholar examined a hieratic inscription copied onto papyrus.
entries.zh: 学者研究了一篇抄写在纸莎草纸上的僧侣书写体铭文。

entries.en: He began to hiccough halfway through the quiet rehearsal.
entries.zh: 他在安静的排练进行到一半时开始打嗝。

entries.en: The courtier treacherously revealed the secret agreement in the final act.
entries.zh: 这名朝臣在最后一幕中背信弃义地泄露了秘密协议。

entries.meaningZh: 迫使人举起双手放脑后前进
entries.en: In the film, the captive is frogmarched away with both hands behind his head.
entries.zh: 影片中，俘虏被迫双手放在脑后前进，被押离现场。

entries.en: The lecturer displayed an echocardiogram beside a labeled drawing of the heart.
entries.zh: 讲师在一张标注了名称的心脏图旁展示了一幅超声波心动图。
